mechanism: The changed decoder accepts any finite recorded and available amounts without checking the configured margin.
trigger: A print requires 100 g at a 10% margin, but both returned amount fields are 1 g.
expectedBehavior: Both response amount fields must equal the rounded requirement of 110 g.
incorrectBehavior: The 1 g response is accepted even though it violates the reservation requirement.
reproduction: Call acceptsReservation(100, 10, {recordedGrams:1, availableGrams:1}); it returns true.
unacceptableAllegations: Claiming the response mutates persisted stock without evidence.
Claiming the configured margin is applied twice.
